final.label: Final SBM (contrast + handoff)
final.note: The SBM of the main results: trained on the contrast data, fine-tuned on the handoff data.

initial.label: Initial SBM
initial.note: Trained on the initial data only, without callsign contrast. Used by the ablations.
initial.where: Section VI.E, Appendices I and J

no_history.label: Without aircraft history
no_history.note: Ablation: the SBM reads the transcript and callsign only.

flow_pca.label: Flow on 18 PCA coefficients
flow_pca.note: The CTP of the main results.

mixture_pca.label: Mixture density on PCA
mixture_pca.note: Eight Gaussian components offset from k-means anchors (MultiPath).

flow_sine.label: Flow on a sine basis
flow_sine.note: Basis ablation: quarter-wave sines with the PCA's number of functions.

clusters_cond.label: Trajectory clusters, conditioned flow
clusters_cond.note: Eight trajectory clusters predicted first, then condition the PCA flow.

prim_bank.label: Primitives (bank angle), clusters
prim_bank.note: Bank-angle profile converted to turn rate with g tan(phi) / V.

adsb_only.label: ADS-B only
adsb_only.note: Same encoder and flow, no instruction tokens.

transcript.label: Transcript-conditioned flow
transcript.note: Reads the transcript tokens directly, no SBM. Initial-data vocabulary.

transcript_sbm_init.label: Transcript-conditioned, SBM-initialized
transcript_sbm_init.note: Text encoder initialized from a trained SBM.
